overall_assessment: Section extraction works well for Steiner: all 13 plans have clean, correctly bounded learning_outcomes, course_content, coursework_requirements (Arbeidskrav kept out of assessment) and assessment, with sensor/aids/ny-utsatt-eksamen logistics correctly dropped. All pre-pass flags (leak->X, long) are false alarms caused by ordinary words like 'vurderingsmåter' or by genuinely long exam descriptions. The only recurring defect is PDF page numbers left as stray lines inside sections.

findings.evidence:
Det benyttes karakteruttrykket Bestått – Ikke bestått.
11
findings.description: Page numbers from the source PDFs (bare lines such as '9', '10', '11', '14') survive inside learning_outcomes, course_content, coursework_requirements and assessment, sometimes mid-list or mid-sentence, e.g. between two learning-outcome bullets. This is navigation/layout cruft polluting otherwise correct text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Steiner course plans are PDF-derived; page footers are not stripped in .clean_sections() or in the anonymization/extraction step.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (R/extract_sections.R), or in a Steiner-specific cleanup, drop lines that consist only of 1-3 digits (regex ^\s*\d{1,3}\s*$) before or after section splitting.
